plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full Notion marketing clone, validating the primary landing flow, product sub-pages, pricing interactions, and mobile responsiveness.
plan.summary: The exploration will start by validating the primary conversion flow on the home page, including CTAs and modals. It will then systematically traverse the product sub-pages (Projects, Wikis) and Templates to verify content rendering and cross-linking. Next, it will deep-dive into the Pricing page's interactive elements like toggles and accordions. Finally, the entire critical flow will be re-evaluated on a mobile viewport to assess layout warnings and tap target usability.
assumptions: CTAs like 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' trigger JavaScript modals or dialogs rather than navigating to new pages.
The pricing toggle switches between Monthly and Yearly views dynamically without a page reload.
FAQ accordions on Pricing and Templates pages expand and collapse content interactively.
The site is a static frontend clone with no backend, so form submissions will not result in actual data saves.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets on navigation links and footer links, especially problematic on mobile viewports.
Pricing toggle (Monthly/Yearly) state changes and ensuring price values update correctly.
Modal dialogs triggered by 'Request a demo' and 'Get Notion free' might lack proper close mechanisms or focus trapping.
FAQ accordion buttons might not provide clear visual feedback when expanded/collapsed.

phases.title: Home Page & Primary Flow
phases.objective: Validate the main landing page structure, primary conversion CTAs, and modal interactions.
key_checks: Verify hero section layout and content visibility.
Click 'Request a demo' and validate the resulting dialog/modal content and close behavior.
Click 'Get Notion free' and validate the resulting dialog/modal content and close behavior.
Scroll through modular product intros and verify section transitions.
exit_criteria: Both primary CTAs have been clicked and their modals successfully closed.
Full page scroll from top to footer completed without layout shifts.

phases.title: Product Sub-pages Exploration
phases.objective: Navigate through Projects and Wikis pages to validate content rendering, feature sections, and cross-navigation.
key_checks: Navigate to Projects page via top nav and verify feature highlights load correctly.
Check cross-linking CTAs on Projects page (e.g., 'Wikis Centralize all your knowledge...').
Navigate to Wikis page via top nav and verify knowledge-base examples render.
Check cross-linking CTAs on Wikis page (e.g., 'Projects Manage any type of project...').
exit_criteria: Both Projects and Wikis pages have been visited from the top nav.
At least one cross-link CTA on each page has been clicked and verified.

phases.title: Templates & Pricing Interactions
phases.objective: Deep-dive into interactive elements on the Templates and Pricing pages, specifically toggles and accordions.
key_checks: Navigate to Templates page and click at least two FAQ accordion buttons to verify expand/collapse behavior.
Navigate to Pricing page and interact with the 'Toggle yearly pricing' control, verifying that prices update.
Click FAQ buttons on Pricing page (e.g., 'How does Notion AI use my data?') to check content expansion.
Verify 'Sign up', 'Get started', and 'Contact Sales' buttons presence and click behavior.
exit_criteria: Pricing toggle has been switched back and forth at least once.
At least one FAQ accordion on Templates and one on Pricing have been expanded.
CTA buttons on Pricing have been interacted with.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Re-evaluate the critical flows and layout warnings on a mobile viewport to ensure responsive design integrity.
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport and verify Home page hero section stacks correctly.
Validate tap target spacing for top navigation links on mobile.
Check Pricing page toggle and accordions usability on mobile.
Verify modals ('Request a demo') are usable and do not overflow screen boundaries on mobile.
exit_criteria: Home and Pricing pages viewed on mobile without horizontal overflow.
Mobile tap target warnings visually validated for top nav.
Modal interactions successfully completed on mobile viewport.

coverage_targets.features: exercise all visible modals, pricing toggles, and at least one FAQ accordion per relevant page
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat critical checks (Home CTAs, Pricing toggle) on mobile viewport

notes: Pay close attention to the small_tap_target layout warnings identified in the prescan, particularly when switching to the mobile viewport in Phase 4.
Since this is a clone, verify that 'javascript:void(0)' links correctly trigger expected UI components like modals instead of failing silently.
